settings.text: Grade 1 kiln-dried & pressure treated wood, not store-grade lumber
A precision cut kit that fits together perfectly
No tools needed except a drill
Designed to hold hot tubs, pergolas, and up to 15,000 lbs
Assembles in just a few hours
Includes a 5-year structural warranty and 25-year warranty on composite boards

settings.label: EASIER THAN TRADITIONAL DIY
settings.heading: It's Not Just Lumber. It's a Professionally Engineered System.
settings.description: It's built for strength, speed, and peace of mind and still costs 30–50% less than hiring a contractor. You're getting:

settings.question: What makes A-DIY different from traditional deck building?
settings.answer: A-DIY systems are engineered for fast, tool-free assembly without compromising structural integrity.

settings.question: Do I need special tools or experience?
settings.answer: No special tools or prior experience is required. Every kit includes step-by-step instructions.

settings.question: How long does it take to build?
settings.answer: Most standard deck kits can be assembled in a single weekend — typically 8–16 hours.

settings.question: What if I have uneven ground or a slope?
settings.answer: Our adjustable pedestal feet accommodate slopes up to 15°. For steeper grades, contact our support team.

settings.question: Why should I choose A-DIY over hiring a contractor?
settings.answer: You save 40–60% on labour costs and retain full creative control.
